quests.name: Simple Note
quests.text: Read the Simple Note and speak to Harutt Thunderhorn in Camp Narache.

quests.name: Etched Note
quests.text: Read the Etched Note and speak to Lanka Farshot in Red Cloud Mesa.

quests.name: Rune-Inscribed Note
quests.text: Read the Rune-Inscribed Note and speak to Meela Dawnstrider in Camp Narache.

quests.name: Verdant Note
quests.text: Read the Verdant Note and speak to Gart Mistrunner in Camp Narache.

quests.name: Welcome!
quests.text: Bring the Camp Narache Gift Voucher to Vorn Skyseer.

quests.name: The Hunt Begins
quests.text: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of Plainstrider Meat.

quests.name: A Humble Task
quests.text: Chief Hawkwind wants you to search for his mother near the water well to the southeast of Camp Narache.

quests.name: The Hunt Continues
quests.text: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts.

quests.name: A Humble Task
quests.text: Take a Water Pitcher from the water well.  Return the pitcher to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache which is northwest from the water well.

quests.name: Rites of the Earthmother
quests.text: Travel to Seer Graytongue who lives in the hills directly south of Camp Narache.

quests.name: Rite of Strength
quests.text: Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.

quests.name: The Battleboars
quests.text: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to kill Battleboars and bring back 8 Battleboar Snouts and 8 Battleboar Flanks.

quests.name: Attack on Camp Narache
quests.text: Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.

quests.name: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha
quests.text: Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills before the incense burns to ash in ten minutes!

quests.name: Call of Earth
quests.text: Bring 2 applications of Ritual Salve to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.

quests.name: Call of Earth
quests.text: Find Kodo Rock and drink the Earth Sapta.

quests.name: Rites of the Earthmother
quests.text: Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of Camp Narache.

quests.name: A Task Unfinished
quests.text: Bring the Bundle of Furs to Innkeeper Kauth in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Break Sharptusk!
quests.text: Bring the head of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle to Brave Windfeather in Red Cloud Mesa.

quests.name: Poison Water
quests.text: Bring 6 Prairie Wolf Paws and 4 Plainstrider Talons to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof.

quests.name: Chakuyak
quests.text: Defeat Chakuyak and bring back her pelt.

quests.name: Rite of Vision
quests.text: Speak with Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Winterhoof Cleansing
quests.text: Use the Winterhoof Cleansing Totem at the Winterhoof Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.

quests.name: Swoop Hunting
quests.text: Bring 8 Trophy Swoop Quills to Harken Windtotem in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: The Great Outdoors
quests.text: Sit near Kaga's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

quests.name: The Adventurer
quests.text: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Camping 101: Cooking
quests.text: Speak with Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village to learn to become a cook.

quests.name: Camping 101: Alchemy
quests.text: Speak with Kray in Thunder Bluff to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

quests.name: Camping 101: Engineering
quests.text: Speak with Twizwick Sprocketgrind in the Venture Co. Mine in Mulgore to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: First Aid
quests.text: Speak with Vira Younghoof in Bloodhoof Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Fishing
quests.text: Speak with Uthan Stillwater in Bloodhoof Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.text: Speak with Komin Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.text: Speak with Chaw Stronghide in Bloodhoof Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.text: Speak with Brek Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.text: Speak with Yonn Deepcut in Bloodhoof Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Camping 101: Tailoring
quests.text: Speak with Vhan in Thunder Bluff to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

quests.name: Sparring Match
quests.text: Defeat 3 other players in duels or Novice Warriors for Tang Stonehoof.

quests.name: Rite of Vision
quests.text: Collect 2 Well Stones and 2 Ambercorn and bring them back to Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Rite of Vision
quests.text: Consume the Water of the Seers in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village and follow the vision once it appears.

quests.name: Thunderhorn Totem
quests.text: Bring 6 Stalker Claws and 6 Cougar Claws to Mull Thunderhorn.

quests.name: Kyle's Gone Missing!
quests.text: Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore wants you to feed his prized puppy, Kyle the Frenzied.  Feed Kyle Tender Strider Meat and return to Ahab Wheathoof.

quests.name: Sharing the Land
quests.text: Kill 10 Palemane Tanners, 8 Palemane Skinners, and 5 Palemane Poachers, then return to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: The Longwalkers
quests.text: Help Perith Stormhoof escape Palemane Rock, and report his safety to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

objectives.text: Escort Perith Stormhoof out of Palemane Rock

quests.name: Thunderhorn Cleansing
quests.text: Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.

quests.name: Dangers of the Windfury
quests.text: Bring 8 Windfury Talons to Ruul Eagletalon in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: The Ravaged Caravan
quests.text: Morin Cloudstalker wants you to examine the contents of a supply crate at the Ravaged Caravan.

quests.name: The Ravaged Caravan
quests.text: Return the Venture Co. Documents to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Mazzranache
quests.text: Bring a Prairie Wolf Heart, Flatland Cougar Femur, Plainstrider Scale and Swoop Gizzard to Maur Raincaller at Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Dwarven Digging
quests.text: Collect 5 Prospector's Picks.  At a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools.  Bring 5 Broken Tools to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Longwalker Malah
quests.text: Find Longwalker Malah Longwind east of Bloodhoof Village, near the edge of Mulgore.

quests.name: Grim Tidings
quests.text: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Our Ancient Enemy
quests.text: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.

quests.name: Rite of Wisdom
quests.text: Travel to Red Rocks east of Thunder Bluff and speak with the Ancestral Spirit.

quests.name: Journey into Thunder Bluff
quests.text: Speak with Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Wildmane Totem
quests.text: Bring 8 Prairie Alpha Teeth to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Wildmane Cleansing
quests.text: Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.

quests.name: Stalk With The Earthmother
quests.text: Sneak into the Venture Company mine southeast of Thunder Bluff and collect 5 Seaforium Mining Charges from carts of blasting supplies, then return them to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Thunderhorn's Report
quests.text: Bring Thunderhorn's Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: The Venture Co.
quests.text: Kill 14 Venture Co. Workers and 6 Venture Co. Supervisors for Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Fizsprocket's Notes
quests.text: Collect the rest of Supervisor Fizsprocket's pages inside The Venture Co. Mine and bring them to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: A Sacred Burial
quests.text: Lorekeeper Raintotem wants you to kill 8 Bristleback Interlopers at Red Rocks.

quests.name: The Hunter's Way
quests.text: Bring 4 Flatland Prowler Claws to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Call of Fire
quests.text: Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.

quests.name: Hex of Weakness
quests.text: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Touch of Weakness
quests.text: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

quests.name: Heeding the Call
quests.text: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Taming the Beast
quests.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Adult Plainstrider. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Taming the Beast
quests.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Prairie Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Taming the Beast
quests.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Swoop. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Training the Beast
quests.text: Speak with Holt Thunderhorn on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Child of Nature
quests.text: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Stalk With The Earthmother
quests.text: Gather 8 Windfury Cones north of Thunder Bluff, use them with the Mortar and Pestle, then return to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff with the result.

quests.name: Stalk With The Earthmother
quests.text: Buy or catch a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then use the Knife Set to fillet it in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Drive Them Out
quests.text: Kill 6 Galak Centaurs, 4 Galak Outrunners, and bring the head of Herak the Pillager to Baine Bloodhoof.

quests.name: The High Chieftain
quests.text: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Supervisor Fizsprocket
quests.text: Kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and return his clipboard to Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Ceasing Operations
quests.text: Bring the Clearcutter Key to Morin Cloudstalker outside Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: The Demon Scarred Cloak
quests.text: Find someone who knows of Ghost Howl.

quests.name: Journey to the Crossroads
quests.text: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.

quests.name: Rites of the Earthmother
quests.text: Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff wants you to bring him the Horn of Arra'chea.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.text: Find Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

quests.name: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon
quests.text: Use the Toxin Extractor to gather 5 Gloomrise Toxin Samples from the Gnawed Corpses at Gloomrise.

quests.name: Defending the Dead
quests.text: Kill 10 Gloomrise Hatchlings and 5 Gloomrise Soldiers.

quests.name: Stronger than Steel
quests.text: Gather 3 strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.

quests.name: A Darker Truth
quests.text: Bring the letter you recovered from Broodmother Valraxx to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.

quests.name: The Broodmother
quests.text: Kill Broodmother Valraxx at Gloomrise.

quests.name: Ancient Gurubashi Idol
quests.text: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.

quests.name: Your First Riding Kodo
quests.text: Inspect the riding kodos to choose your first mount.

quests.name: Learning to Ride
quests.text: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Kar Stormsinger.

quests.name: Darkmoon Beast Deck
quests.text: Return the Beast Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.

quests.name: Darkmoon Portals Deck
quests.text: Return the Portals Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.

quests.name: Darkmoon Warlords Deck
quests.text: Return the Warlords Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.

quests.name: Darkmoon Elementals Deck
quests.text: Return the Elementals Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.

quests.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
quests.text: Travel to Palemane Rock in Mulgore and seek out your fortune.

quests.name: Unstable Magic
quests.text: Bring 10 Motes of Unstable Magic to Nuara Tremorhoof.
